import subprocess, sys
# Test 1: pysemver without arguments - should raise SystemExit
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "semver"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(f"=== No args ===")
print(f"returncode: {r.returncode}")
print(f"stdout: {r.stdout[:200]}")
print(f"stderr: {r.stderr[:200]}")

# Test 2: pysemver bump without specific part - should show bump help
r2 = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "semver", "bump"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(f"\n=== bump (no part) ===")
print(f"returncode: {r2.returncode}")
print(f"stdout: {r2.stdout[:300]}")
print(f"stderr: {r2.stderr[:200]}")
